page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, utilizing an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate average single-core performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1549.0 and a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1896.09. However, multi-core and memory bandwidth capabilities show distinct limitations. The multi-core Geekbench score of 3261.0 and the Passmark CPU score of 5899.34 are categorized as weak. Memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks is poor, measuring 15.81 GB/sec for read-only operations, while multi-threaded bzip3 decompression is also poor at 21.54 GB/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7t.xlarge offers a high density of memory relative to its compute resources, making it suitable for memory-bound workloads that do not require intensive multi-threaded processing or high-speed local disk access. Appropriate workloads include static web serving, which achieved an average throughput of 6.4 GB/sec, single-threaded text processing, and lightweight database operations or caching systems that fit entirely within the 32.0 GB memory footprint.
